title: Belgium: Flanders JoKER — the stall gate
executive_summary: Belgium has no federal Intergenerational Impact Assessment. The live instrument is Flemish: Jeugddecreet Article 7 JoKER (kind- en jongereneffectrapport) on Flemish Government draft decrees that directly affect children and young people, now through age 30. It is the only IIA-family tool in the GYC corpus with documented dossier-blocking bite — the Council of State required a missing JoKER in opinion 69.100/1 (18 May 2021). Completing JoKER unblocks the file; it does not force a rewrite. After the 13 March 2026 age-30 expansion, bill 864 filed a completed JoKER and the Council did not stall it.

layers.label: Flemish statutory JoKER
layers.role: Mandatory annex on Flemish Government ontwerpdecreten that directly affect children and young people: effects with the measure, without it, and alternatives to avoid, limit or remedy serious harm.

layers.label: Council of State stall gate
layers.instrument: Raad van State / Conseil d'État legislation section
layers.role: Can require a missing JoKER before the dossier proceeds. Completing the report unblocks; no merits veto on a completed JoKER.

layers.label: Federal and Walloon gap
layers.instrument: None enacted in the GYC corpus as of 17 August 2026
layers.role: No federal IIA, no Walloon equivalent located, no Future Generations Commissioner.

constitutional_reform.instrument: Belgian Constitution — no national IIA clause
constitutional_reform.significance: Belgium's IIA story is Community/Region procedure in Flanders, not constitutional entrenchment.

articles.text_en: Flemish Government draft decrees that directly affect children and young people must include a kind- en jongereneffectrapport in the explanatory memorandum, covering effects with the measure, without it, and alternatives. Population: tot en met 30 years after 13 March 2026.

jurisprudence.overview: The Council of State stall is procedural: missing form blocks; completed form does not rewrite. That distinction is the whole bite story.

streams.label: JoKER stall versus completed filing
streams.summary: One stall precedent (2021). One post-expansion completed filing that did not stall (2026).

key_cases.subject: Closed-supervision youth-justice bill missing JoKER
key_cases.holding_en: The Council required a missing JoKER before the bill could proceed. The report was written two days later.
key_cases.significance: Only IIA-family instrument in the corpus with documented dossier-blocking bite.

key_cases.subject: JoKER filed after the 13 March 2026 age-30 expansion
key_cases.holding_en: A completed JoKER travelled with the government bill. The Council of State did not stall it.
key_cases.significance: After expansion, completing JoKER is routine. Stall remains a missing-report gate, not a youth-merits veto.

operational_tests.test: Flemish Government ontwerpdecreet that directly affects children and young people (through age 30). Not member bills or ministerial orders.
Sponsoring minister and administration; CJM advises within 12 working days. Not an independent KomJC-style unit.
Council of State can stall a missing JoKER. Nobody can force a rewrite of a completed one.

vig_framework.statutory_principle: Effects with the measure, without it, and alternatives to avoid, limit or remedy serious harm, inserted in the explanatory memorandum.
vig_framework.definition: Mandatory child-and-youth impact report on in-scope Flemish Government draft decrees, covering persons through age 30 after March 2026.
vig_framework.integration: Explanatory memorandum of the ontwerpdecreet; Council of State legislative review can demand a missing report.
vig_framework.trigger: Every Flemish Government draft decree that directly affects children and young people.
exclusions: Walloon and Brussels instruments (no equivalent located)

recommendations.text: Do not describe Belgium as having a national IIA — it is Flanders JoKER.
Do not treat a completed JoKER as bite; stall is the missing-report gate only.
Do not clone a Walloon or federal IIA that has not been published.

local_practice.detail: JoKER is written by the sponsoring administration with CJM advice. Independent checker model (KomJC) is not used.

comparative_notes.contrast: Dutch generatietoets cannot stall. Flemish JoKER can stall a missing report — and only that.
KomJC is independent and high-volume but non-binding. JoKER is ministry-authored and procedurally harder to skip.
Italian VIG is national and statutory but DPCMs unpublished. Flemish JoKER is subnational and already operating with a stall precedent.

litigation_track.relevance: Procedural stall, not constitutional IIA review.
